A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same RELOCATE research work, including complete main text and Appendices A–B. Their text, equations, seven figures and ten tables support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original RELOCATE benchmark results, ablations, timing measurements, hyperparameter sensitivity experiments and an appendix comparison with SAM 2.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendices A–B, including RELOCATE evaluations and the SAM 2 comparison.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same prepare, search, refine, track and reiterate pipeline, including SAM segmentation, DINO features, similarity matching, candidate filtering and query expansion.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate visual query localization on Ego4D VQ2D, retaining the same validation/test coverage and sampled validation cases. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SiamRCNN, CocoFormer and VQLoC, with NFM included only in validation comparisons in both versions. The feature-extractor comparisons and Appendix B SAM 2 comparison also retain their comparator membership.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, four evaluation metrics, model configurations, processing settings and 100-example appendix comparison remain unchanged. The new compute acknowledgement does not establish a change in experimental settings.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same representation comparisons, refinement/reiteration ablations, failure analysis, qualitative examples and four-parameter sensitivity analysis. Appendices A–B introduce no additional analyses in v2.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or statistical significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–10, plotted results, timing measurements and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, RELOCATE test stAP25 remains 0.35 in Table 1, and its 100-example subset stAP25 remains 0.378 in Table 9.

T1.justification: The formal VQL task definition, response-track notation and maximum cosine-similarity expression in Equation (1) are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same training-free localization contribution, region-representation benefits and refinement/query-expansion claims, including the claimed 49% relative spatio-temporal AP improvement over prior methods.

C2.justification: The explanations of representation benefits, refinement and query expansion remain unchanged, as do discussions of ambiguous queries, wrong-object failures, computational cost and possible speed optimizations.

D1.justification: The new acknowledgements disclose use of NCSA Delta GPUs through ACCESS allocation CIS240541. This adds compute-resource provenance; existing implementation settings, NVIDIA A40 timing information and code/data access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 42 references and related-work discussion are retained. Bibliography entries move across pages following the acknowledgements addition, without changes to cited works or research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgements section, changes the supplementary overview's references from 'Appendix A/B' to 'Sec. A/B', and updates the arXiv version/date text. The scientific narrative is otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgements reflow the bibliography on PDF pages 9–10, and the conclusion paragraph has slightly different line wrapping. Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–10 retain their content, structure and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 provides more complete funding and compute attribution and makes small editorial/layout adjustments. The methods, empirical evidence, explanations and limitations—including both appendices—remain unchanged, so the additions do not produce a meaningful overall quality difference.
